verdict.rationale: llama.cpp supports VLM inference via llama-mtmd-cli and llama serve, with documented usage of models like Gemma-3 and Qwen for image+text understanding, corroborated by hands-on community reports of it working well including OCR-like tasks and benchmarks. missing for 10: broader coverage of supported VLM architectures/limitations and more first-party documentation depth beyond GitHub README bullet points.
